findings.title: Repair path relies on changesets/action outputs and tags surviving a failed `changeset publish`
findings.label: valid
findings.note: eqlAssets throws or reports not-on-npm without thisRun or a changesets tag (eql-release-assets.mjs:91-105), and the release.yml comment's claim that changesets/action sets publishedPackages after a failed publish is untested (tests inject it), so the 3.0.6 repair may fail on every push.

findings.title: npm listing lag beyond 15 minutes blocks every JS release in that run
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The timeout behaviour is accurately described, but the finding itself concludes it is a loud, recoverable, intended trade-off and recommends accepting it.

findings.title: Repair rebuild runs head's reusable workflow against an older source tree
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The new repair path calls head's local reusable workflow (pinned mise 2026.4.0, head's task invocation and paths) but checks out an older inputs.ref, a tooling mismatch the change introduces; it plausibly causes build failures or SQL that does not match the npm tarball.
